items.summary_en: ‘Godzilla’ event currently brewing could push 50 million people into acute hunger before the end of next yearA series of strong El Niño climatic patterns in recent decades, such as the “Godzilla” event currently brewing that is set to warp weather around the world, have been supercharged by the broader overheating of the planet caused by the burning of fossil fuels, a major new study has found.El Niño is a naturally occurring phenomenon, taking place every two to seven years, when the waters of the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean heat up, causing a cascade of impacts around the world. The latest developing El Niño, set to peak later this year, is set to be the strongest in living memory and has been informally dubbed a “Godzilla” event. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: 一项正在酝酿的“哥斯拉”级事件可能导致明年年底前有5000万人陷入急性饥饿。一项重要新研究发现，近几十年来一系列强烈的厄尔尼诺气候现象——例如 目前正在酝酿、即将扭曲全球天气的“哥斯拉”事件，均因化石燃料燃烧导致的全球范围过热而进一步加剧——一项重要的新研究得出了这一结论。厄尔尼诺是一种自然现象，每隔两到七年发生一次，此时热带太平洋东部海域水温升高，从而在全球范围内引发一系列连锁反应。 目前正在形成的最新一轮厄尔尼诺现象预计将于今年晚些时候达到峰值，这将是有记录以来最强的一次，已被非正式地称为“哥斯拉”事件。继续阅读...
